description: A unit citing a Need id the paired document does not carry.
specRow: S9.4 NEED-REF-001 fires when a needRefs[].id does not resolve to any need.id in the paired document.

needsDocument.title: Benefits assistance -- who this is for and why

statement.who: anyone submitting this application under a deadline
statement.want: a receipt I can save and show someone later
statement.why: if the agency loses my submission, I lose rights I actually had
statement.done: after I submit, I hold a receipt that proves what I filed and when

note: Design-choice record. The typo'd citation leaves `proof-of-filing` served by nothing, so NEED-COVERAGE-001 fires alongside NEED-REF-001 — two defects, two codes, one root cause.
